description.value: Jack's Spot is a small, independently operated cafe on Kingsway in East Vancouver, offering coffee, matcha, sandwiches, bread, and pastries. Its Instagram-only web presence gives it a distinctly local, community-facing character on this busy commercial corridor. Cyclists passing through the Kingsway strip will find it a compact neighbourhood spot for a quick coffee and bite.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL points to an Instagram profile (jacks__spot), but the fetched pages returned only generic Instagram login/navigation content with no business-specific information, making it effectively unverifiable as a content source. All evidence therefore relies on OSM tags: the record describes a cafe at 3615 Kingsway offering coffee, matcha, sandwiches, pastries, and bread, with outdoor seating and customer internet access noted. Because OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website confirmation, Wi-Fi and outdoor seating cannot be confirmed as amenities.
